mapper.select: SELECT g.id, g.member_id, m.name AS writer, g.content, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM guestbook g JOIN member m ON m.id = g.member_id ORDER BY g.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE guestbook SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO guestbook_reply (guestbook_id, parent_reply_id, member_id, content) VALUES (#{guestbookId}, #{parentReplyId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.guestbook_id, r.parent_reply_id, r.member_id, m.name AS writer, pm.name AS parent_writer, r.content, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM guestbook_reply r JOIN member m ON m.id = r.member_id LEFT JOIN guestbook_reply p ON p.id = r.parent_reply_id LEFT JOIN member pm ON pm.id = p.member_id ORDER BY r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE guestbook_reply SET content = #{content}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
